about: Which loop blocks enclose each operator, read by both LogicalPlanSpec (the backend's LogicalPlan.enclosingLoopStarts) and loop-block.util.spec.ts (the frontend's port of it), so the two cannot drift apart. In each case, enclosingLoopStarts maps every operator inside a block to the Loop Starts of the blocks it is inside, outermost first (fewer Loop Starts around a Loop Start first, then by id); an operator outside every block is absent. The values are the backend's answers: LogicalPlanSpec prints a case's own answer when they differ.
